source: NESO day-ahead constraint flows and limits (SCOTEX)
meta.scotex_note: scotex_limit_mw / scotex_flow_mw: NESO day-ahead constraint flows and limits for the SCOTEX boundary (Scotland to England). flow is NESO's day-ahead forecast of the flow the market wants; when it exceeds the limit, the excess must be turned down. Latest published values, not outturn.
meta.method: curtailed_mwh = accepted bid volume; level_mw = pn_mw - 2 x curtailed_mwh; state: instructed if curtailed; unavailable if PN exceeds MEL by >max(1 MW, 5%) or PN and MEL are both ~0; unknown if PN ~0 while MEL > 0 (farm planned no output before gate closure, not a paid BM action) or PN missing
